'''Jamborite''' is a [[Minerals#Geode Minerals|mineral]] that can be found in the [[Geode]] and the [[Omni Geode]].

==Bundles==
Jamborite is not used in any [[bundles]].

==Recipes==
Jamborite is not used in any recipes.

==Tailoring==
Jamborite is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[Tailoring|Green Thumb Shirt]].  [[File:Shirt205.png|24px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a green dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Quests==
Jamborite is not used in any [[quests]].

==History==
{{History|1.4|Can now be used in [[Tailoring]].}}
